training_policy: Preserve each native model architecture and objective; freeze effective native training recipes before cloud smoke. Do not inherit CASE-EPCL optimizers, PCGrad, losses, clipping, ramps, or step budgets.

data.identity_reference: Current CASE ED cache, exported without importing src
data.knowledge_policy: Use preexisting CASE ED cached COMET and ConceptNet/VAD features with per-model layout adapters; standardized-data reproduction, not author-cache replay

evaluation.full_generation_policy: Only after clear overall improvement or explicit user request, per audit rules v3
evaluation.common_search: cumulative_log_probability_keep_finished_beams_v1; length_penalty=0; max_dec_step is generated tokens including EOS
evaluation.historical_generation_reference: Re-export CASE-EPCL under the same search and text protocol before final generation ranking; do not reuse old Distinct/Beam numbers directly

checkpoint_policy.baseline_primary: native Valid PPL best with deterministic validation; exact aggregation, validation batch and effective stopping recipe must be frozen per model before cloud launch
checkpoint_policy.case_epcl: Report composite_best and ppl_best together with equal standing, per audit rules v3; retain their existing selection algorithms

remaining_before_training: Freeze effective per-model batch, training budget, validation/save frequency and early stopping
Provide the formal training entry point; use cloud N=500 for subsequent comparison generations
